name: survos/brevo-bundle
description: Brevo (ex-Sendinblue) for Symfony: the official SDK on Symfony HttpClient, list/campaign commands, and webhook events re-dispatched for any listener.

suggest.symfony/brevo-mailer: Send mail with MAILER_DSN=brevo+api://KEY@default, and parse Brevo webhooks.
suggest.symfony/webhook: Receive Brevo webhooks at /webhook/brevo; this bundle re-dispatches them as BrevoMailEvent.
